_comment: Per-robot calibration for block 2 of the emitted sketch.
Source for robot 1: DOKUMENTACIO_robot1.md section 5 (2026-09-08, parquet).
PWM_PER_MMS / PWM_NULLA / PWM_MIN of robot 1: re-measured 2026-09-13 with keret-ep v6 (408 imp/rev) at 10.5 V, PWM 30..120 sweep; PWM 30 already moves (~125 mm/s).

NYOMTAV_MM of robot 1: 143 was tuned for the v5 engine (free wheel dragged). With v6 (exact pulse sums) 3 spins ended short at 143 and 146.5; the user measured 148.3 as exact (2026-09-13; physical track 148).

Robot 2 (2026-09-13, 9.3 V): speed line from a PWM 50..120 sweep (0.155 / 38.0: deadband ~45-50, right wheel ~20 % faster at equal PWM), PWM_MIN 50; MM_PER_IMP copied from robot 1 (1 m measured right on the floor), BAL_TRIM 1.000 (straight). NYOMTAV 157.0: at 148.3 the spins ended 50 (left) / 70 (right) deg short of 1080 -- this robot slips ~6 % in spins, and unevenly; check its right tyre. Its PWM wires + encoders are crossed -> firmware v7 flag N,-1,1,-1,1,1.

Robot 3 (2026-09-14, 9.3 V, brought up from a Mac): MM_PER_IMP + speed line copied from robot 1 (1 m forward/back on the mark), BAL_TRIM 1.000 (no drift), PWM_MIN 45. NYOMTAV 152.5: at 148.3 both 3-spin turns ended 30 deg short -> x 1080/1050. Wired like robot 1 (N,-1,1,-1,1,0). Sketch: RobotBaseStats/SHOW_robot3.md.

Robot 4 (2026-09-20, 9.8 V, USB bring-up): N,AUTO -> N,-1,1,-1,1,0 (wired like robot 1; its right encoder GND was unplugged at first -- reseated). G,408,408 -> 409/412. Deadband sweep M,p,p: left unreliable below 40 (94 imp at 30 vs right 451), both track from 50 -> PWM_MIN 45. PWM 50 -> ~280 mm/s, 60 -> ~335 mm/s = robot 1's line, so 0.145/9.30 copied. Floor run 1 at NYOMTAV 148.3 / BAL_TRIM 1.000: 1 m forward ended ~97 cm and drifted slightly LEFT, 1 m back on the mark, both 3-spin turns ~20 deg short -> NYOMTAV 148.3 x 1080/1060 = 151.1, BAL_TRIM 1.004 (left target +0.4 %).
Robot 5: calibration is null until MERESI_MENET.md has been done on them.
The emitter refuses to produce a file for a robot with null calibration.
